description: Reads one model's documents and returns, per file, its type, alias, legal name, date of birth, site and whether it is signed; flags duplicates, name spelling variants and unreadable files.
input: a model's document set (jpg, png, pdf)
output: output.json: the model, its aliases and one entry per file, with a one-line summary

steps.description: builds the request with every file as an image
reads every file and answers in JSON
